name: nexu-io/html-anything
description: An HTML editor app with embedded agentic template skills, including a product spec template and an investor pitch deck template. Users pick templates in the app; adding a skill means copying a similar skill folder and editing its SKILL.md frontmatter.
install: git clone https://github.com/nexu-io/html-anything.git, then run the app with pnpm -F @html-anything/next dev to use the template picker
